final: WITH magnet_k8 AS (SELECT s.City, f.`NSLP Provision Status` AS provision_status FROM schools AS s JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND s.GSserved = 'K-8') SELECT City, COUNT(*) AS schools_in_city, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT City) FROM magnet_k8) AS number_of_cities, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM magnet_k8 WHERE provision_status = 'Multiple Provision Types') AS multiple_provision_schools FROM magnet_k8 GROUP BY City ORDER BY City
